notes.title: The early access of " Survival Simulator" is coming soon.
notes.content:
Survival Simulator is a hardcore survival sandbox game under civilized doomsday. Struggle to survive on a perilous and unknown planet. Environment, climate and creatures are threats all the time, but also may be your powerful boosts. The early access is coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751863/14a8a3f1fea913eef612f970977f0afa9b80c0df.png[/img]

This EA version has random world and events, combat and technoloy system, more creatures and monsters, save slots, to ensure a stable play duration for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751863/c68dfe1a6da5b4f8c0ad6df0dd089d136aacf0aa.png[/img]

We will add more rich contents and gameplay in the official version, including Co-op play, new story and interaction with other players and NPCs. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38751863/c09356804a7e0a89f57e9159b848d7f4302fc6c3.png[/img]

We will track the comments of the community and hope that players will leave comments for our solving more problems. Thank you!

If you have any problems in the game or want to give us your valuable suggestions, please add our QQ group, your feedback is our best motivation:
Welcome to the player base: 871858953
